company.name: Keynua
company.shortDescription: Keynua is a provider of e-signatures used to identity verification and validating transactions.
company.description:
Keynua is a developer of an e-signature platform used for identifying individuals and validating their transactions. Its platform uses 3-second video signatures with identity verifications that serve to approve specific documents as well as provide the visual identity of the signatory that enables users to get rid of tedious identity verifications and safeguards them from frauds.

Keynua was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Lima, Peru.
